content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Advise the owner and architect on site use, materials, systems, constructability, procurement, labor availability, lifecycle and alternative costs, and accelerated or phased scheduling."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Develop increasingly detailed cost estimates through design, evaluate alternatives, submit estimates for review and approval at each phase, and flag overruns with corrective recommendations."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Prepare and negotiate a detailed guaranteed-maximum-price proposal, documenting drawings, specifications, assumptions, trade/system costs, allowances, contingency, fee, milestones, schedule of values, and acceptance deadline."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Obtain at least three subcontractor and specially fabricated-material/equipment supplier proposals, submit them for owner selection, and use subcontractors within 50 miles unless the owner approves a greater distance."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Manage the renovation under construction-manager-at-risk terms, commence construction after the GMP amendment or owner notice to proceed, and administer authorized written changes affecting scope, price, or time."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Prepare the construction schedule after the GMP amendment and provide monthly written progress updates showing percentage completion and other owner-required information."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Maintain cost controls against the schedule of values, monitor actual and remaining costs and proposed changes, and report variances monthly to the owner and architect."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Comply with applicable laws, codes, public-authority orders, equal-employment requirements, and other required governmental programs."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Purchase and maintain the owner-required construction-contract insurance throughout all project phases."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"If the owner directly purchases kitchen or brewery equipment, coordinate its installation with the supplying vendor."}]}
